title: Test-Time Immunization: A Universal Defense Framework Against Jailbreaks for (Multimodal) Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical defense framework (TIM) for protecting LLMs and MLLMs against jailbreak attacks. While it aims to prevent 'unethical' or 'harmful' content, its focus is on model robustness and security (preventing the circumvention of safety guardrails) rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
